A selection of academic projects from engineering school: applied statistics, machine learning, data visualization, web application development. Most were team projects; the summaries below cover the problem, the methods, and the tools.

---

## M2 Projects

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}

### Eye-Tracking Analysis

**Technologies:** R, Statistical Modeling, Signal Processing

Analysis of eye-tracking data to study visual attention patterns: protocol design, data acquisition in Tobii Pro Lab, fixation metrics, statistical analysis in R.

[<i class="bi bi-github"></i> View on GitHub](https://github.com/antoinelucasfra/eye-tracking_M2){.btn .btn-dark .btn-sm}

:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}

### Co-Inertia Analysis

**Technologies:** R, Multivariate Statistics, ade4

Co-inertia analysis with ade4, studying relationships between paired data tables. The deliverable was the statistical study plus a xaringan slide deck.

[<i class="bi bi-github"></i> View on GitHub](https://github.com/antoinelucasfra/co-inertia_project){.btn .btn-dark .btn-sm}

:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}

**Technologies:** R, JavaScript, HTML/CSS

Interactive visualizations for communicating complex results, focused on usability, narrative flow, and exploratory interaction.

[<i class="bi bi-github"></i> View on GitHub](https://github.com/antoinelucasfra/visu_project){.btn .btn-dark .btn-sm}

### Shiny Web Application (M2)

**Technologies:** R, Shiny, shinydashboard, ggplot2

An interactive R Shiny app for data exploration with dynamic filtering, reactive summaries, and user-facing plots.
